# FINANCIALS — 2026-W45 (week to 2026-11-07)

## Coverage changes
Five BANKS initiations published on 7-Nov, all BUY. [BMRI](coverage/companies/BMRI.JK/report.md) **BUY 5,731** (+72.4% TR); [BBCA](coverage/companies/BBCA.JK/report.md) **BUY 6,192** (+28.1%), the no-re-rating book-compounding call on the least rate-sensitive funding base; [BBNI](coverage/companies/BBNI.JK/report.md) **BUY 5,674** (+82.3%) at 0.68x book; [BBRI](coverage/companies/BBRI.JK/report.md) **BUY 4,201** (+68.7%), carrying the desk's through-cycle 3.35% credit cost on a 43%-micro book; [NISP](coverage/companies/NISP.JK/report.md) **BUY 1,476** (+32.3%). Targets span +28% to +82% and COE 12.45% (band floor) to 12.80% tracks beta, so the all-BUY tilt is a market-multiple fact rather than one shared input. Coverage gap: BRIS.JK is blocked at draft — the pack has no NII/NOII line, so the bank template cannot resolve TOI→NP→EPS; it needs an OPS pack fix or the owner's LK drop at `data/coverage_inbox/financials/BRIS.csv`. No view. PNBN, BBTN and BJBR are in draft tonight; 97 FINANCIALS initiations remain queued, and no INSURANCE, MULTIFINANCE, CAPITAL_MARKETS or FINANCIAL_HOLDCOS name is published.

## Deck moves
No move in the forward path. The macro deck — the only deck these names read — holds usd_idr FY2027E 18,350, BI-Rate 5.75%, CPI 3.28% and real GDP 5.29%; the usd_idr spot was re-marked to Rp18,003.5/USD on 6-Nov [deck macro S7][S4][S5]. The balance_of_payments_pressure / CAUTIOUS regime and the INDO rate-sensitive AVOID tilt were held at 31-Oct; that tilt is the input behind NISP's 3.30% NIM. The next full regime rebuild is due 7-Nov.

## Material news
BINA is placing 350m shares with two Anthoni Salim entities (6-Nov). KB Bank (BBKP) completed the 85% sale of KB Bukopin Finance for Rp339.97bn (5-Nov). BRIS shareholders approved a 6.8bn-share rights issue on 6-Nov; free float is 9.33% against the 15% floor. BNLI Q3-2026 net profit was Rp2.57tn, −10.9% y/y. Tugu Insurance 9M-2026 net profit was Rp495.15bn, +17.4% y/y.

## What to watch
BRIS: rights-issue terms and whether the pack fix lands, unblocking the initiation. PNBN, BBTN, BJBR: draft completion and sign-off. BBCA: the 1-Dec second rupiah reserve-requirement step. Macro: the 7-Nov rebuild, and whether DXY or Brent trips a marker and moves the rate-sensitive tilt.

Research only; not investment advice.
